intro: EXOBASIS is operated by Exobasis LLC. This page identifies the provider and gives its address for legal correspondence and direct contact details.

sections.title: Responsible provider
sections.body:
Exobasis LLC
Legal form: LLC
Authorised representative: Raphael Rechberger

Exobasis LLC operates EXOBASIS and is your contracting party for the services agreed with EXOBASIS. Raphael Rechberger acts on behalf of the company.

sections.title: Address for legal correspondence
sections.body:
Legal notices and postal correspondence can be sent to:

Exobasis LLC
131 Continental Dr, Suite 305
Newark, DE 19713
United States

sections.title: Direct contact
sections.body:
For legal notices, questions about the provider or contractual matters, contact Exobasis LLC at legal@exobasis.com. You do not need to purchase a consultation, book an appointment or use an encrypted messenger.

You can also send privacy requests to legal@exobasis.com. The Privacy notice explains the processing of personal data and your rights.

Representative contact: Raphael Rechberger, raphael@exobasis.com.

The Service and contract terms explain the working relationship and how an assignment is agreed. For general organisational questions, see Private enquiry.

sections.title: Registration and competent authorities
sections.body:
Exobasis LLC is responsible for the agreed advice on personal preparations, planning, organisation, implementation and ongoing support. Where part of an assignment requires a specific professional qualification or regulatory authorisation, the responsible specialist or company and their role are identified in that assignment. A specialist’s authorisation is not an authorisation held by Exobasis LLC.

For questions about the identity or role of the provider, write directly to legal@exobasis.com. You can also use Private enquiry for an organisational question.

If your question concerns the provider or your contract, go to Private enquiry.
